sources.title: Policy and charging control over Rx reference point
sources.content_basis: Self-authored paraphrases of an accessible existing editorial-summary explanation; the original standard was not reopened.
limitations: Not a complete Rx state machine or error-code catalogue.

verification.scope: Listed group resource operations, access, creation, forwarding and subscription claims only; referenced mechanisms have their own evidence boundaries. GMC re-subscription/notification, MCS server subscriber and constituent-group GMS subscriber request claims checked; proxy and full SIP state machines not implied.  Memberlist-free retrieval default, POST request and response conditions.  Temporary group creation check/notification and teardown success boundaries; no invented rollback.  GKTP resource creation, SIP-only access, authorization and non-constituent MCPTT payload recipients.  Subscription proxy and owner authorization identities and rejection boundaries.  Distinguish unknown extensions in group documents, GKTP and GMOP.

Listed interworking scope, configuration, regroup boundaries/media and group-call request claims only. Late entry, group release and encrypted-transcoding claims are also checked; referenced underlying protocols are not. Selected chat entry/release and de-affiliation exit claims checked. Chat initiation and preconfigured-regroup concept claims checked. Affiliation representation, direction and per-group information-flow claims checked. Location queries, notifications, subscription/cancellation, talker privacy, simultaneous calls, SDS addressing/disposition and opaque LMR security transport checked only to the claims in their topic records. Manual private call, release and encryption claims checked; automatic setup and underlying TS23.379/33.180 remain outside this batch. Selected floor-signal semantics checked, not the full floor-control state machine. Floor-control ownership, filtering examples and conditional override checked; no complete arbitration implementation.

limitations: TS23.283 §10.11.4.2.3.2 reverse-subscription response has conflicting figure/text endpoints; retained explicitly in its topic.
Referenced TS23.280 location fields, TS23.379 call mechanisms, TS23.282 SDS procedures and TS33.180 key management are not independently verified by this source record.

verification.scope: Listed identity, emergency, alias, access-disable and location-privacy claims only.
Selected transmission admission, reception/selection and no-receiver requirements only; no complete protocol implementation.
Listed MCData delivery, conversation, transmission, receiving, off-network-private and termination claims only.

sources.role: Normative reference used by TS24.481 V19.3.0; RFC itself has no 3GPP Release.

verification.scope: Listed addressing, write/delete validation, conditional-update and namespace-selector claims only; not the entire RFC or current HTTP specification.

Only the claims in primary-registration, registrar-routing, eps-signalling, location/on-demand-usage, location/report-acquisition, location/subscription-lifecycle and location/history-recovery are checked. Includes selected §10.9.3.2 acquisition behavior; full configuration/cancellation IE sets, Stage3 encoding, PLMN LCS, storage/deletion policy and complete SIP/security/QoS mechanisms are not verified. Selected partner migration authorization and de-authorization claims (§10.6.2–10.6.3) checked; TS33.180 cross-domain security and active-call continuity remain unchecked. Selected pre-selected versus active profile switching conditions, per-client scope, group-data ordering and old-state cleanup checked.  User profile acquisition in primary and partner systems, including conditional validation.  Network-initiated and UE-initiated user profile updates and bounded update granularity.

limitations: Distinct earlier Rel19 version; no claim of equivalence to V19.10.1 location topics.

verification.scope: Selected flow/profile/ARP and no-alternative-profile notification claims; not full PCC or 5QI mapping.

sources.role: External SIP baseline; RFC has no 3GPP Release. No assertion of a complete Rel19 MCX SIP profile.

verification.scope: Dialog identifier, request route construction and target-refresh boundary only; subsequent updates and extensions not checked.

Selected HTTP/SIP access, native code-flow constraints, service authorization and identity binding, token refresh, partner-token exchange and migration authorization, KMS roles/provisioning, on-network private-key distribution, group-key delivery and membership-change handling. External security profiles, complete OIDC/JWT validation, full KRR/MIKEY/SRTP and call state machines remain unchecked. Also selected UE key persistence/deletion triggers and group SRTP derivation inputs versus on-network/off-network SRTCP protection boundaries; complete algorithms and Annex H remain unchecked. MC gateway two-layer authentication and forwarding boundaries checked in 5.12.1; referenced TS33.501 not checked. Selected initial CSK upload, per-server CSK replacement and MuSiK rejection/unicast boundary checked. Selected public-safety XML application-layer activation, content scope, integrity-body coverage and MC-server visibility checked; W3C implementation/KDF remains unchecked. Selected MCData signalling/data key roles, private SDS/FD reuse, protection versus authentication prerequisites and visible protected-payload metadata checked; full Stage3 formats and algorithms remain unchecked. Protected multi-talker MCPTT mixing/forwarding and preconfigured group/user regroup key prerequisites checked. Bounded KRR purpose, policy narrowing, Home-domain trust and hold/deny controls checked; ambiguous selection and signed-policy wording explicitly unresolved, no selection algorithm claimed. Token response ID/refresh optionality compared against TS24.482 V19.0.0 without resolving cross-document obligations.

limitations: V19.4.0 only; no equivalence to V19.5.0 asserted.
Selected claims only; consult each topic for applicable conditions and unresolved dependencies.

verification.scope: Only unknown/unsupported namespace child-condition evaluation and identity child OR, as referenced by TS24.48119.3; not complete Common Policy.

Selected Annex A HTTP transport and sender identity branches only. Sender identity branch and UE assertion rejection checked. UE endpoint and TLS identity checks. Version-bounded token response obligations and textual discrepancies compared with TS33.18019.4 tables. Bounded authorization-to-token HTTP sequence and home security-token handoff.

limitations: V19.0.0 only; no equivalence to later versions or complete cross-specification compatibility asserted.

verification.scope: Selected bearer resource request error and transport rules only; no current TLS profile. Selected error status recommendations, single carrier, and frontend/backend confidentiality.

Selected on-demand private-call terminating-client branches; not full call state machine. Client rejection, MIKEY gate, manual response and pre-answer cancellation verified. Six explicit commencement mode predicates, no invented fallback. Originating identity binding, selected permissions and routing boundaries. Terminating participating prerequisites, forwarding precedence and incoming policy. Control role gates, PSI routing, ringing conversion and conditional unconfirmed final response. FTA permission, selected target filtering, winner response and losing-branch cleanup.
